title: Kate NDE 7198
content: I had a vacuum-like feeling. I was sucked into a field of unearthly brilliant color with a large tree to my right in the distance and feeling of a non-human escort companion on my left. It was a feeling that I did not have to worry about my children or anything that I was leaving behind. All would be well. All was well and good; but then, knowledge that I could not stay. I was aware of darkness without time, and then once again, the feeling of being thrown or sucked into this field of brightness, peace and knowledge. I was walking once again through the field with the beautiful tree on my distant right and companion/escort on my near left. I was happy to be back, only to feel the knowledge that I had to go back again and could not stay because I had work to do. There was no feeling of time. I awoke to feeling of suffocation, was in recovery on a breathing machine. I felt extreme pain, burry vision and nurses' voices telling me that the machine was breathing for me. Three days later, I learned from my doctor that they 'lost' me twice. The last thing I remembered was hearing, while on the operating table, the doctor shouting that she wanted an incident report.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Vacuum-like feeling; felt 'sucked' in and later 'thrown or sucked' back into the field of brightness.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'non-human escort companion' felt on her left.

environment.environment_other_detail: A field of 'unearthly brilliant color' with a 'large tree' to her right in the distance; later described as a field of 'brightness, peace and knowledge.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt 'thrown or sucked' back; later awoke in recovery.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She 'could not stay' and 'had work to do.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated cycling: darkness/void-like phase followed by re-entry into the bright field with escort and tree.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Vacuum-like pull into bright field with escort; then 'darkness without time'; then again pulled/thrown into the bright field; then return to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Entered the bright field twice, separated by 'darkness without time.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Repeated alternation between a bright field scene (with a distant large tree and non-human escort) and a 'darkness without time,' along with sensations of being 'sucked' or 'thrown.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I had a vacuum-like feeling.” “I was sucked into a field of unearthly brilliant color…” “I was aware of darkness without time…” “I could not stay because I had work to do.” “they 'lost' me twice.”
